title: Luminance Mace PvP Resource Pack
description: This resource pack changes some textures, very important for MPvP (Mace PvP), to lighter versions.
body:
![visual](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8818b446d758b98595a54dff64575228fe55188.png)

# About the resource pack:
This resource pack changes the textures of key Mace PvP elements, making them more contrasting and convenient for dynamic battles:

Mace: Received a new bright texture and a powerful combat look that stands out perfectly in dynamic Mace PvP.

Firework Rocket: Overhauled with vibrant, noticeable colors for easy tracking in the air.

Crossbow: Completely reskinned with bright details to match the overall style of the loaded rockets.

Elytra: Got a bright and high-contrast texture for maximum visibility during high-speed flights.

## Note: 

Please do not install this resource pack together with other similar ones to avoid conflicts.
